people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
translations.bsb: The next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
translations.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
translations.asv: Now on the morrow, as they were on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray, about the sixth hour:
